summary: iter236 3-mission bundle verified end-to-end. PYTEST: 52/52 PASS (offline) + 6/6 PASS (live HTTP). FRONTEND: Marketplace card layout PASS (3-col grid, card-display-price/card-price-label/quick-bid-btn/view-item-btn all rendered ×5). Map panel toggle PASS (mounts map-search-panel + container + radius-slider + info-banner; slider min=10/max=500/step=10/value=50; banner says 'Showing listings within 50 km of your selected location'). AIAssistant PASS — widget header reads 'BidVex AI Core' (no 'Master Concierge'), input present, send fires POST /api/chat/stream with X-GenAI-Model=gemini-2.5-flash + Transfer-Encoding: chunked + Content-Type: text/plain. Streaming verified at byte-level: 581 byte arrivals over 0.249s span (real chunked delivery — iter234 GZipMiddleware bug appears resolved on text/plain stream path since content-encoding is no longer applied to /api/chat/stream by ingress). WATCHDOG instruction contains all Section 5 markers AND retains iter235 anti-hallucination locks. Backend anti-hallucination: real-listing chat reply did not invent '$100 fee' or '3% fee'. KNOWN-AS-EXPECTED: catalog has 0 listings with location.coordinates → geo items=[] (preview limitation, not a bug). FINDINGS: (1) MapSearchPanel is NOT mounted on /lots page (only on /marketplace) — spec said both pages. (2) Lots page currently has 0 lots in preview catalog so lot-quick-view-btn / 200px image / 420px min-height could not be visually verified — data-dependent, not a code bug. (3) iter233 multiplier badge testids count=0 on visible cards because none of the 5 preview listings have price_multiplied_by_quantity=true (data-dependent, behaviour is locked by unit tests which all pass).

minor.issue: X-Accel-Buffering: no header set by route is missing from the public response (visible as None in browser network panel). Same iter234 finding — the route emits it; ingress/Cloudflare strips it. However, Transfer-Encoding: chunked IS preserved and byte-level streaming WAS verified (581 byte arrivals over 249ms), so end-user UX is fine; only the header advertisement is gone.

From Chromium devtools the response shows content-encoding=gzip on the SSE-like stream while raw Python/curl requests show no content-encoding. This is a UA-conditional re-compression at the edge. Doesn't break delivery (chunked transfer still works) but worth noting if anyone re-debugs the iter234 buffering issue.
